consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1986-05-04 show at California Exposition Amphitheater featured strong performances, particularly in the first set and during the Drums>Space segment. Highlights include energetic renditions of several songs, with many praising the overall vibe and musicianship of the band.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 22 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance and highlighted specific songs, there were also comments about low energy and mixed feelings about the overall show quality.
